name: Madcala

categories.label: Reduced opponent's HP to 0
categories.hint: Yes if your opponent's hit points reached 0.

winCondition: The game ends when a player's hit points reach 0; the other player wins. No point scoring.
notes: family: abstract-objective (HP elimination duel, Mancala-style shard movement). Most characters start at 25 Health (some expansion characters lower, e.g. 15); the first player to bring the opponent to 0 wins. Draw/stalemate handling not stated in any source. Official rulebook PDF only on BGG Files (403 from this environment), so confidence stays medium.
